environment: Hermes Native locked Rust workspace with agent-automation; egui_kittest UI harness and captured test Gateway command. No live Hermes Gateway or installed app was used.
notes: An egui PasteImage event sent while the message composer owns focus is consumed by the real composer path, atomically staged as a PNG, and emitted as a Gateway attachment command scoped to the active connection, profile, stored session, and runtime session. The test verifies the staged image bytes are a readable 2x2 PNG. This does not verify physical Windows clipboard delivery, authenticated Gateway upload outcomes, or packaged-app behavior.
